limits: These are literature references, not matched comparisons against A08. No A08 result was measured on either original test.
AUROC is not accuracy or F1. Different test datasets and class spaces must not be ranked together.
EchoViewCLIP Table 1 and the results paragraph report standard-view accuracy 0.968; its abstract instead says 96.1%. This record explicitly uses Table 1, not the inconsistent abstract.
EchoViewCLIP Table 1 reports F1 without specifying its averaging convention in the evaluated paragraphs. It is not relabeled macro-F1 here.
EchoViewCLIP Table 1 AUROC values describe OOD recognition, not standard-view classification; they are intentionally omitted from the view AUROC column.
The EchoPrime row on Guangdong is the EchoViewCLIP authors' fine-tuned baseline, not the original EchoPrime paper's CSMC checkpoint score.
Original pixels/complete expert labels are not obtained; frozen A08 has five outputs rather than the original 38/58 classes. Full native-task comparison remains unmeasured.
